vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: geo-prompt-architecture
Version: 0.1.2

The geo-prompt-architecture bundle is a comprehensive framework for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategy. It provides structured instructions (SKILL.md), JSON schemas, and reference playbooks to help an AI agent generate and audit marketing prompts for brand visibility in AI search engines. The content is entirely consistent with its stated purpose, lacks any high-risk capabilities like shell execution or data exfiltration, and contains no evidence of malicious prompt injection or obfuscated code.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only prompt-architecture playbook for generating GEO monitoring prompts; it requires no credentials, no installs, and its instructions align with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (GEO Prompt Architecture) match the provided SKILL.md, examples, schemas, and references. No binaries, env vars, or external credentials are required; the included schemas and example files are consistent with a prompt-generation / audit tool. The only mild surprise is the repo metadata: source/homepage are missing and owner is an opaque ID, but this is a provenance note rather than a capability mismatch.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md and referenced 'final-topic-first-generator-prompt.md' give detailed, prescriptive runtime instructions for reconstructing a client model, building topic maps, generating prompts, scoring, and producing structured outputs. It explicitly recommends (but does not require) live browsing to validate website-derived topics, and it requires outputs structured using the packaged schemas. It also requires analysis/structure to be in Chinese (while allowing prompt text in English for English-speaking markets). These are not security issues but are important runtime constraints for an agent.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files; this is instruction-only. That is the lowest-risk install model — nothing is downloaded or written to disk by an install step.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, no credentials, and no config paths. The SKILL.md explicitly states no private credentials are needed for basic operation and warns not to assume access to analytics or private docs unless provided. Requested environment/credential access is proportionate (none).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and disable-model-invocation is false (normal). The skill is instruction-only and does not request persistent presence or system-wide configuration changes.

dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only prompt-architecture repo for GEO monitoring and appears internally coherent: it needs no installs, no credentials, and its runtime instructions match the stated purpose. Things to consider before using: (1) provenance — the source/homepage are not provided and the owner ID is opaque; prefer verified sources if that matters for your organization. (2) The skill recommends — but does not require — live web browsing to validate inferred topics; only allow browsing if you trust the agent/browser capability. (3) The final generator prompt asks for analysis/structure in Chinese (with English prompts allowed for English markets) — be sure this language requirement fits your workflow. (4) Do not paste private analytics, Search Console data, CRM exports, or credentials into the agent unless you explicitly trust the skill and the receiving system. Overall this repo is coherent and low-risk for installation, but validate source trust and avoid sharing secrets when generating prompts.
